ICICI Bank Shares Dip Post Q2 Earnings Amid Mixed Market Sentiment

ICICI Bank shares closed lower following the release of its second-quarter earnings. Despite the dip, three brokerage firms maintained a bullish outlook on the bank's stock. The broader Asian market sentiment was mixed, with some indices showing gains while others stumbled, influenced by investor anticipation of Artificial Intelligence sector earnings and a prior rally in US stocks driven by strong corporate results.
